findings.cwe_name: Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers
findings.review_comment: The session secret is generated using Math.random(), which is cryptographically weak and predictable. This secret is used to sign session cookies, creating a vulnerability where attackers could predict or brute-force session tokens. Replace Math.random() with crypto.randomBytes() or a cryptographically secure PRNG to generate the 32-byte session secret.
